core_obligations: Set up the spectral sequence (proof lines 5481-5492): the filtration by truncations of a representative of K gives a spectral sequence with E_2^{p,q} = H^p(U, H^q(K)) converging to H^{p+q}(U, K).
Degeneration (proof lines 5492-5499): hypothesis (2) makes all terms with p greater than zero vanish for U in B, so the spectral sequence degenerates and H^q(U, K) = H^0(U, H^q(K)) for those U.
proof_roadmap: Take the truncation spectral sequence of a representative of K.
Use the vanishing hypothesis on the objects of B to kill the columns p greater than zero.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for an object of the derived category whose cohomology sheaves are acyclic in positive degrees on the objects of a covering family B, the cohomology at those objects is computed by the zeroth cohomology of the cohomology sheaves (statement lines 5466-5479). The proof uses the spectral sequence attached to the truncation filtration, with E_2^{p,q} = H^p(U, H^q(K)) (proof lines 5481-5492), and observes that the hypothesis kills all columns with p greater than zero, so the spectral sequence degenerates (proof lines 5492-5499). The non-formal content is the degeneration argument. The claim is H2: one spectral sequence plus one vanishing input.
